role: The mail composer sheet for a morning recovery report: subject with the report date in the app language, recipients and CC from the user's recovery-report defaults (falling back through UserSettings' resolved defaults), the exported file attached. Presented by MorningResultsView.reportMailComposer.
types: RecoveryReportMailComposer: struct (View) — wraps MailComposerView for one report
toplevel: Stored settings (a UserSettings value captured when the sheet is built), reportDate and attachmentURL, set by the memberwise init.

units.does: MailComposerView with subject 'Recovery Report – <reportDate, abbreviated date in the app language>', recipientList(from: settings), ccList(from: settings) and the attachment.
units.entry: SwiftUI body, when MorningResultsView's report file sheet shows .mail

units.does: Recipient list from the given settings: [the recovery-report default] when it is non-blank after trimming spaces; otherwise UserSettings.resolvedDefaultEmailRecipient (first non-empty of recovery, training, legacy — so a recovery address of only spaces is the one returned there), as a one-element list, else empty.

CC list from the given settings: the recovery CC split on commas, trimmed, empties dropped; when that is empty, UserSettings.resolvedDefaultEmailCC (the first non-empty CC string among recovery, training, legacy, parsed the same way, so a recovery CC of only commas/spaces yields []).
